structured.approach: I read feat.tasks to find this lane's tasks: TSK-03 and TSK-04 in ap_forecast. org.permission_table is restricted, so I used it only through the tool view (tool:repo-access), which says no secrets are required or granted for ap_forecast. To check that nothing in the code needs a credential, I searched ap_forecast case-insensitively for environment, key, secret, token, password and HTTP patterns. I also read explain.py, models.json and ci.py. A task.secrets_scope.md from an earlier run (marked attempt 4) was already at the output path. I read it first, then replaced it with a fresh attempt-1 file based on the evidence above. I did not use a connector: OSV and PyPI don't help here, because the lane adds no dependencies.

claims.text: The Data Science lane covers TSK-03 (STORY-03) and TSK-04 (STORY-04) in the ap_forecast repository.
The permission table requires and grants no secrets for ap_forecast.
TSK-03 is rule-based. It uses no LLM, makes no network call, does not read models.json, and risk.py imports only predict_delay_days.

TSK-04 only appends the risk level to the prompt. The provider, model and max_tokens still come from config or load_config(). Sending the label to acme-llm waits on TQ-8, which gates release, not coding.
build_explanation_request reads models.json and returns a request dict. It makes no outbound call and imports only json and pathlib.
models.json names provider acme-llm and model acme-text-2 and contains no key or endpoint.
ci.py runs compile, unit tests, coverage and static checks locally and needs no credential.
Every environment (local/CI, feature branch, dev, main) requires and is granted no secrets, so no access request is needed.

open_questions: SSQ-1 (non-blocking): Which component sends the build_explanation_request payload to acme-llm, and who owns its credential? This is outside TSK-03 and TSK-04. If ap_forecast ever calls the provider directly, DS-02 must be re-entered.
structured.summary: I wrote task.secrets_scope.md for FEAT-ZD-48600. The Data Science tasks TSK-03 and TSK-04 in ap_forecast need no secrets in any environment, and the permission table grants none. Required and granted access match, both empty, so no access request was raised. A search of the code confirmed there are no credential reads and no outbound calls. One non-blocking question (SSQ-1) asks who owns the acme-llm credential.
